подтема: Image-модели — часть серии Gemini (нативно мультимодальные reasoning-модели)
title_en: Image models are natively multimodal reasoning models
content_en: The image model is a member of the Gemini series of highly-capable, natively multimodal reasoning models.
applies_when_en: The prompt is long and detailed, or the task expects the model to understand meaning and context rather than produce a picture from keywords.
not_applies_when_en: The task is choosing a specific model of the family; that is covered by the model-selection rule.
caveats_en: Gemini Image models are natively multimodal and respond effectively and efficiently to even the most detailed prompts (models: pro, nb2, lite).

Built on the Gemini 3 family of models, Nano Banana models apply deep reasoning capabilities to fully understand the prompt before generating an image; they use real-world knowledge and deep reasoning to deliver precise, rich visual results (models: nb2, pro).
Gemini 3 Pro Image is the next generation in the Gemini series of natively multimodal reasoning models and comprehends text and images (models: pro).
Input is text, images, audio and video; image and text output is generated in the response (models: nb2, lite).
Native image generation means the Gemini model itself generates images; Gemini 2.0 Flash adds text and image generation with a single model (models: nb25, other).
canaries_en: Generate an image from this long, detailed scene description
Illustrate the meaning of this paragraph, not just its keywords

terms.значение_en: the Gemini series: one model understands several modalities and reasons; the image models are its members
the image is generated by the Gemini model itself (not by a separate diffusion generator)

title_en: Models have a fixed knowledge cutoff date
content_en: The model knows the world without search only up to its knowledge cutoff date; the cutoff date differs by model.
applies_when_en: The prompt refers to recent events, new products, people, facts or current data dated after the model's knowledge cutoff.
not_applies_when_en: Search grounding is enabled (pro, nb2), so recent facts come from search; or the scene is not tied to recent events.
caveats_en: Knowledge cutoff date: January 2025 (models: pro, nb2).
Knowledge cutoff date: June 2025 (models: nb25).
Nano Banana 2 and Nano Banana Pro both have a knowledge cutoff date of January 2025 (models: pro, nb2, other).
The knowledge cutoff date for Gemini 3 Pro, the text base model, was January 2025 (models: other).

Illustrate this week's top news headline
Create an infographic with the latest current statistics

terms.значение_en: the date up to which the model knows the world without search

подтема: Знание мира и фактичность по моделям
title_en: World knowledge yields more factual images
content_en: The image model connects a vast knowledge base (world knowledge) to produce more factual assets than previous image generation models.
applies_when_en: The prompt needs real facts: a diagram, an infographic, a map, historical or scientific details, or specific places and objects.
not_applies_when_en: The image is pure fantasy or stylization without factual content.
caveats_en: Vast knowledge base and more factual assets; in the Gemini app it has the highest level of world knowledge (models: pro).
Built on Gemini 3 Pro, Nano Banana Pro uses state-of-the-art reasoning and real-world knowledge to visualize information better than ever before (models: pro).
Nano Banana 2 brings the advanced world knowledge, quality and reasoning of Nano Banana Pro at lightning-fast speed, making them more accessible (models: nb2).
In the Gemini app, Nano Banana 2 is described as having more world knowledge and Nano Banana Pro the highest level of world knowledge (models: nb2, pro).

Image generation models historically excelled at aesthetic images but lacked a deep, semantic understanding of the real world; Gemini 2.5 Flash Image benefits from Gemini's world knowledge, which unlocks new use cases, and uses extended world knowledge and reasoning to generate contextually relevant images (models: nb25).
Factuality research expanded to images helps improve the quality of the video and image model families, including Veo, Imagen and Nano Banana (models: nb25, other).
canaries_en: Make an infographic of the water cycle
Draw a historically accurate map of ancient Rome
Create a labeled diagram of the human heart

terms.значение_en: knowledge of the real world inherited from Gemini; the basis of factual images
images with factually correct content (infographics, diagrams)

подтема: знания о мире → точные инфографики, схемы, объяснялки (по моделям)
title_en: Models create accurate infographics and explainers
content_en: With its advanced reasoning, the model creates more than beautiful images: it creates accurate educational explainers, such as context-rich infographics and diagrams, based on the provided content or on facts from the real world.
applies_when_en: The task is an infographic, a diagram, an educational explainer, a data visualization or a location mockup, with content from the provided material or from well-known facts.
not_applies_when_en: The scene is artistic without factual content, or the task needs fresh data from the web (that is grounding with search).
caveats_en: Visualizes any idea and designs anything, from prototypes to representing data as infographics to turning handwritten notes into diagrams (models: pro).
Improved world knowledge: creates diagrams and infographics with more accurate info (models: nb2).
World knowledge at draft level: quickly drafts accurate contextual scenes, rough data visualizations and location-specific mockups (models: lite).
Gemini 2.0 Flash leverages world knowledge and enhanced reasoning to create the right image, such as illustrating a recipe (models: other).
canaries_en: Make an educational infographic explaining photosynthesis
Turn my handwritten notes into a clear diagram
Create a diagram of the process described in this text

terms.значение_en: the model's knowledge of the real world, used without search
rough data visualizations (wording used for Lite)

подтема: галлюцинации и общие ограничения базовых моделей
title_en: Models can hallucinate like foundation models
content_en: The model can exhibit some of the general limitations of foundation models, such as hallucinations.
applies_when_en: The task needs exact facts, numbers, names, place names, recent events or lettering based on real data.
not_applies_when_en: The scene is purely artistic without facts, where inaccuracy is not an error.
caveats_en: Gemini 3 Pro, the text base model, can exhibit general foundation-model limitations such as hallucinations; there can also be occasional slowness or timeout issues (models: other).
Gemini 2.0 Flash strives for accuracy, but like all language models its knowledge is broad and general, not absolute or complete (models: other).
canaries_en: Create an infographic with population figures for European capitals
Draw a labeled map with the correct city names
Make a chart of last year's sales numbers with exact values

terms.значение_en: incorrect information invented by the model; named as a general limitation of foundation models
the date up to which the model knows the world

подтема: Gemini 2.0 Flash: как нативная генерация создаёт картинки (механизм)
title_en: Native generation combines input, reasoning, language understanding
content_en: The model combines multimodal input, enhanced reasoning and natural language understanding to create images.
applies_when_en: The task needs an explanation of where the model gets its world knowledge and conversational editing: the image is a native output of the language model.
not_applies_when_en: The task is choosing a model today: Gemini 2.0 Flash was the experimental predecessor, and Pro, NB2 and Lite are current.
canaries_en: Explain why the image model can edit pictures through conversation
Explain where the image model gets its world knowledge

terms.значение_en: image generation by the multimodal Gemini language model itself, without a separate image model
